question: Should OpenClaw temporarily accept the pre-standard 2026.7.2 beta envelope format alongside standard DSSE, and what concrete release or migration event retires that acceptance path?
rationale: This is a deliberate compatibility expansion in signature-verification code; tests can show the parser works but cannot determine the supported upgrade window or permanent trust contract.

options.title: Confirm temporary beta fallback
options.body: Keep the all-or-nothing legacy reader for the named beta snapshots and record a specific owner and retirement event before merging.

options.title: Use standard DSSE only
options.body: Remove the legacy reader and require beta users to obtain a migrated or freshly signed catalog before updating.

recommendation.title: Confirm temporary beta fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the all-or-nothing legacy reader for the named beta snapshots and record a specific owner and retirement event before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor supplied the producer-consumer interoperability evidence and documented the proposed beta compatibility scope; owner confirmation should be routed through that linked feed work.
